caseName: Tennessee Electric Power Co. v. Ickes
caseNameFull: Tennessee Electric Power Co. v. Ickes, Administrator of the Federal Emergency Administration of Public Works
attorneys: Mr. Spencer Gordon for appellant., Acting Solicitor General Bell for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion of the appellee to affirm is granted and the decree of the District Court is affirmed. Alabama Power Co. v. Ickes, 302 U. S. 464; Duke Power Co. v. Greenwood County, 302 U. S. 485.
